summary: Iter46 retest of iter45 contact-form bug fix. Backend: POST /api/support/contact verified for (a) 200 + {message:'Received', id:'con_*'} on valid authed driver message, (b) 400 'Message required' on empty & whitespace-only message, (c) 401 when unauthenticated, (d) doc persisted in admin_contact_requests with user_id, role='driver', status='pending', created_at (verified via admin GET /api/admin/crud/contact_requests). Frontend: /chauffeur/support/contact happy path shows 'Message envoye !' toast + clears textarea, and on forced 500 the UI now correctly shows 'Erreur d’envoi, reessayez' error toast with textarea preserved (no more silent success). All 5 pytest tests pass + Playwright success+failure flows pass. Iter45 bug is fully fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: DriverSupportPage.handleSendContact correctly checks res.ok now and throws into catch, producing toast.error. Clean, idiomatic.
New /api/support/contact endpoint is minimal and uses get_current_user (raises 401 when absent) + 400 on empty message; strips whitespace. Looks good.
Consider adding a Pydantic model (e.g., SupportContactCreate) instead of raw dict parse for symmetry with other routes (low priority).
test_credentials: Driver created at runtime via POST /api/auth/phone-register with role=driver (random +336######## / Driver123!). Admin: admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! (used to list admin_contact_requests).
seed_data_creation: Per-run: 1 driver user + 1-2 admin_contact_requests docs (TEST_iter46_*) inserted via the new endpoint. Low impact, no cleanup endpoint in current backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter45 contact-form bug is closed. Regression file /app/backend/tests/test_iter46_support_contact.py covers the four contract cases (200/400/401 + persistence). Reuse it in future iterations. UI selectors confirmed: [data-testid=contact-message], [data-testid=contact-send] on /chauffeur/support/contact. Sonner toast nodes queryable via [data-sonner-toast] with data-type attribute 'success' or 'error'.
rca of the issue: Fix verified: backend/routes/misc.py ships a new POST /api/support/contact that calls get_current_user (401 if missing cookie), validates non-empty trimmed message (400 otherwise), and inserts into admin_contact_requests with role copied from user. Frontend DriverSupportPage.handleSendContact now throws on !res.ok so the try/catch routes 4xx/5xx to toast.error instead of toast.success. Both ends wired correctly; no silent-success regression.
